include(FetchContent)

set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE} CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_USE_CCACHE OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_DOC OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_PYTHON_API OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_TESTS OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_DISABLE_EXCEPTIONS ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_DEBUG_INFO ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_USE_MELKOR OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_ASM OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_ELF ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_PE ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_COFF ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_MACHO ON CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_DEX OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_ART OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(LIEF_OBJC OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")

FetchContent_Declare(
  lief
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/NullOnSec/LIEF.git
  GIT_TAG extended_build_patch
  GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(lief)
